title: l2: lichen_make_gua() has zero callers — evaluate removal or scope blessing
description: Discovered during zt3c.7.2 (which removed the sibling lichen_make_ula). lichen_make_gua (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.c, 2000::/3 constructor) has no callers in lichen/ per repo grep. The LICHEN addressing model (spec 6.1/12) is link-local fe80:: + key-derived 0200::/8; 2000::/3 GUA is not part of it. Decide: delete like make_ula, or keep and bless for future prefix-delegation use — header doc currently says 'GUA for prefix delegation compatibility'.
